title: tabernaemontana venusta
intro: Tabernaemontana venusta, commonly known as Yellow Chalice Vine, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical regions of Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana venusta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids like venustine, which exhibit potential anticancer, antiviral, and neuroprotective activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of this plant as a medicinal agent.
